title: Architecture Intentions — start here
body:
Architecture Intentions is a design-time, intention-led architecture planner for the Project Alchemy ooRexx estate. It is not the source of business facts, the Intentions dispatcher, the SSC resolver, a policy enforcement point, or the Deployment executor.

Baselines: v0.1-dev8 delivered as the Library archive on 2026-10-11; v0.1-dev9 candidate on 2026-10-23 adds an optional read-only SSC receipt/admission class. GitHub source delta and documentation are published separately from the complete ZIP; do not mistake this sphere for deployment admission.

Discover actual business scope first: legacy MySQL/flat files, ownership of customer/cat/device identity, actors and trust zones, obligations, business features, throughput, availability, cost and geography. Do not assume all 27 stack layers are needed.

Architecture policies carry scope, issuer, effective revision, and mandatory/allowed/forbidden choices. Contradictory rules fail as authority conflicts, not silently overridden.

Each scenario preserves all alternatives, questions, issues, component relationships and candidate dependencies. Changing the deployment model must not mutate the initial business intention.
